detail.longDescription: What made you want to build your homelab? I’ll go 1st. When I started my current role about two years ago, I was thrown straight into managing Kubernetes clusters. I quickly realized how much I DIDN’T know. Within a week of starting, I bought a Beelink mini PC, learned how to build a cluster with kubeadm, and started my homelab journey so I could learn by building, breaking, and fixing things myself. # DevOps # k8s # learnk8s # cncf # 100DaysOfCode # 100DaysOfDevOps # kubernetes # technology # homelab
